title: claude-settings guard: an agent never moves a lane's branch or a shared branch name
why: Two incidents on 2026-11-08. (1) A round-1 designer agent in lane duo-gaps-design-review (PR 237) ran `git checkout -B`, which moved the lane's branch under the lane's checkout and left stale staged files. (2) In lane orders-ext-ui-tests, an agent moved its branch name under the main checkout, which was left detached at 854c6cf. Both were restored; nothing was lost.
note: Feedback for claude-settings, which the owner carries (sessions never edit claude-settings). Proposed guard: refuse an agent's `checkout -B`, `branch -f` or other ref move on the lane's own branch or on a branch another checkout holds. Folds in lane orders-ext-ui-tests' proposed step agent-ref-moves-shared-branch. Reported via the coordinator, 2026-11-08 20:14 and 20:24 CST.
